name: symphony-config-jql
jql: project = "CS" AND issuetype in ("产品需求") AND status not in ("草稿", "审核中") AND status in ("Open", "In Progress") ORDER BY created ASC

name: symphony-candidate-jql-string-fields
jql: project = "CS" AND status in ("Open", "In Progress") ORDER BY created ASC
errorBody: {"errorMessages":["Can not deserialize instance of java.util.ArrayList out of VALUE_STRING token\n at [Source: org.apache.catalina.connector.CoyoteInputStream@374ad046; line: 1, column: 116] (through reference chain: com.atlassian.jira.rest.v2.search.SearchRequestBean[\"fields\"])"]}

name: status-category-open
jql: project = "CS" AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC

name: skill-product-req-default
jql: project = "CS" AND issuetype in ("产品需求") AND statusCategory != Done AND status not in ("草稿", "审核中") ORDER BY updated DESC

name: baselinereq-planned
jql: project = "BASELINEREQ" AND status in ("已计划") ORDER BY updated DESC

name: cs-open-in-progress
jql: project = "CS" AND status in ("Open", "In Progress") ORDER BY updated DESC

name: dev-todo-states
jql: project = "CS" AND status in ("待开发", "开发中") ORDER BY updated DESC
